sources.title: Sunflower-Qwen3.5-9B - SALT Documentation
sources.snippet: Sunflower-Qwen3.5-9B is an adaptation of Qwen3.5-9B to understand text in 67 African languages. The model was optimised for translation, instruction-following and multi-turn chat in these languages.
